description: Interface areas computed in the preceding run, plotted: what actually holds Cas2/3 in the recruited complex compared with the AcrIF3 interface
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, os
# values computed in the preceding Shrake-Rupley run (1.4 A probe, 64 points per atom, alt loc A, no waters)
rows=[("AcrIF3 dimer on PaCas3 (5B7I, 2.60 A)",2486,4973,"inhibitor interface"),
      ("Cas1 on Cas2/3 (8K22, 2.92 A)",2662,5323,"holds Cas2/3 in the recruited complex"),
      ("nucleic acid on Cas2/3 (8K22)",1409,2819,"holds Cas2/3 in the recruited complex"),
      ("Csy complex on Cas2/3 (8K22)",841,1681,"the surface AcrIF3 occludes")]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["interface","area_per_side_A2","buried_total_A2","role"])
out=os.getcwd(); df.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"table4_interface_areas.csv"),index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nAcrIF3 interface / Csy interface ratio: %.2f"%(2486/841))
print("fraction of the Cas2/3 partner interface in 8K22 contributed by Csy: %.1f%%"%(100*841/(2662+1409+841)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4,4.3))
cols={'inhibitor interface':'#cc3311','holds Cas2/3 in the recruited complex':'#4477aa','the surface AcrIF3 occludes':'#ddaa33'}
b=ax.barh(df["interface"][::-1],df["area_per_side_A2"][::-1],color=[cols[r] for r in df["role"][::-1]])
for bar,v in zip(b,df["area_per_side_A2"][::-1]): ax.text(v+40,bar.get_y()+bar.get_height()/2,f"{v} A$^2$",va='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("interface area per side (A$^2$), Shrake-Rupley, 1.4 A probe")
ax.set_xlim(0,3200)
ax.set_title("AcrIF3 buries three times the area that Csy buries on Cas2/3,\nbut Cas1 and DNA bury more still in the recruited complex",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
